disqualifier.note: Not one scope: fileTouched is the per-file dirty flag in the sourceFile loop; renamed is a nested ensureNamespaceImport return latch. A file can be touched without a rename, and rename is counted separately via aliasRenamed.
PrCloseoutReport.retriggeredGreptile is a request/result echo of one CLI toggle, not exclusive closeout phases.
Independent collectFiles predicates: file-name vs directory-name. One is applied to files and the other to directories, not as exclusive flags on one record.
Independent path-family tests. Combined-true is legal (packages/ecosystem/.../src is both) and used as separate lane inputs.
Independent path filters: filename brand vs effect-drizzle layout vs fixture/docs exclusion. Combined-true of drizzle plus excluded is unused rather than a masked union.

evidence.note: The success writer sets ok from diagnostics length === 0. Missing-file, parse-failure, and decode-failure writers at 302-330 pair ok false with a nonempty diagnostics list.
reportAllowlistCheckSummary branches on ok then prints diagnostics; ok with a nonempty list is not a handled success.
